item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The world of metals and non-metals
item.stem:
Ravi hangs an iron bicycle chain outside his home in Jaipur. His teacher says rust forms on iron only when it touches both air (oxygen) and water.

In which situation will the chain rust the fastest?

options.A: The chain is kept in a closed dry cupboard inside the house.
options.B: The chain is painted with a thick coat of red paint.
options.C: The chain is left in the open during the rainy season, exposed to air and rain.
options.D: The chain is fully dipped in boiled water kept in a sealed bottle.
